title: Multi-browser living-room E2E + rename visual→e2e (#98)
summary: Adds a five-context living-room night with seeds and page objects, adopts them across visual specs, and rewires the harness for snapshots and UI Mode. Loosens dependencies to ranges and ships an audit report, a QR fix, and mechanical renames.
why: Single-surface goldens cannot catch pairing, presence, break mode, or cross-client sync bugs [bugs](source:s1). The goal is one scripted living-room night proving that contract [night](source:s1).
lookFor: Issue [#98](source:s1) asks that living-room sleeps and races be called out in the PR. The [PR](source:s2) only checks the 10× flake box. The spec header documents the 12.5s TTL wait, playback touch, and heartbeat waits, and no source names why the PR omits them.

[PR](source:s2) says `pnpm test:e2e:ui` sets `E2E_UI=1` and skips webServer for an instant list. `package.json` runs plain `--ui` with no env and `playwright.config.ts` only skips on `E2E_HARNESS_ONLY=1`. UI Mode still starts `server.sh` with fresh Convex, and no source names why the skip went away.

The [commit](source:s3) says it pins Playwright to 1.62.1. `package.json` bumps to `^1.62.1` and loosens 30+ exact pins to `^` ranges. No source explains the broad loosening beyond the Playwright bump.

groups.title: Living-room night
groups.why: Proves pairing, presence, break mode, and cross-client sync that single-surface goldens cannot [goldens](source:s1). Implements the requested living-room night [night](source:s2).
groups.summary: The `living-room.spec.ts` night uses `seedLivingRoom` and the `openHost`/`openTv` factory to drive five contexts.

attention.note: The night waits 12.5s past the 12s TV TTL then sends a pause command to force `getForHost` to recompute. Without the wait and touch, the host query keeps stale `tvConnected` and the remote shell stays visible. Reviewer decides whether the fixed sleep plus write is acceptable for the disconnect check.

fileNotes.e2e/live/living-room.spec.ts: Drives host, TV, Remote, Alex, Blair lobby to finish.
fileNotes.e2e/seed/living-room.ts: Seeds lobby game with two songs.
fileNotes.e2e/pages/living-room.ts: Opens five contexts via surface page objects.

groups.title: E2E runner and config
groups.why: Provisions local Convex and Vite for the suite. Wires platform snapshots and UI Mode [Mode](source:s2).
groups.summary: The `playwright.config.ts` runner wires `server.sh`, platform snapshots, and `test:e2e:ui`.

attention.note: `server.sh` deletes `.env.local` on start and on exit via trap. A developer with their own `.env.local` overrides loses them when the webServer runs. Reviewer decides whether deleting local config outside test output is acceptable.

fileNotes.e2e/playwright.config.ts: Loads env, splits projects, wires server.

groups.title: Dependency ranges
groups.why: Bumps Playwright to 1.62.1 [1.62.1](source:s3) and loosens exact pins to ^ ranges.
groups.summary: Renames `test:visual` scripts to `test:e2e` and loosens exact pins to `^` ranges.

attention.note: A fresh install when Convex 1.43.1 exists installs 1.39.1 under the old exact pin and 1.43.1 under the new `^` range. The suite then runs against newer Convex helpers and TanStack code. Reviewer decides whether floating installs are acceptable in a PR about E2E.

groups.title: QR hook fix
groups.why: Stabilizes host and TV QR readiness [readiness](source:s3).
groups.summary: The `useQRCodeSVG` hook memoizes by primitive and ignores late resolves.

attention.note: `useQRCodeSVG` memoizes by primitive width, margin, and colors instead of the options object and ignores resolves after unmount. Host and TV QR surfaces re-render without regenerating SVG each time. Reviewer decides whether the production change belongs in a PR about E2E.
